SELECT pi.*, it.name AS institution_type_name, a.area_name AS area_name, u.user_name AS manager_name, os.name AS operation_status_name, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cu.user_name), '') AS cleaners_name_str FROM public_institution pi LEFT JOIN sys_institution_type it ON pi.institution_type_id = it.sys_institution_type_id AND it.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON pi.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON pi.manager_id = u.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON pi.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON FIND_IN_SET( cu.user_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(pi.cleaner_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND cu.deleted = 0
GROUP BY pi.id, it.name, a.area_name, u.user_name, os.name ORDER BY pi.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pi.id) FROM public_institution pi LEFT JOIN sys_institution_type it ON pi.institution_type_id = it.sys_institution_type_id AND it.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON pi.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON pi.manager_id = u.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON pi.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0
